tha-ap146:1.1: Saparivāriya.] Padumuttaro nāma jino lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / jalitvā aggikkhandho va sambuddho parinibbuto. // //
tha-ap146:2.1: Nibbute ca mahāvīre thūpo vitthāriko ahu / thūpam rattaṃ upaṭṭhenti dhātugehe varuttame. // //
tha-ap146:3.1: Pasannacitto sumano akaṃ kañcanavedikaṃ / dīyati dhūmakkhandho ca thupānucchavikaṃ tadā. // //
tha-ap146:4.1: Bhave nibbattamānamhi devatte atha mānuse / omattam me na passāmi pubbakammass' idam phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap146:5.1: Pañcadase kappasate ito aṭṭha janā ahuṃ / sabbe Pamattanāmā te cakkavattī mahābalā. // //
tha-ap146:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Saparivāriyo thero i. g. a-ti.
